Every clique in the point-collinearity graph is contained in one line; the line simplices meet at most in vertices and retract after stellar subdivision to the point-line incidence graph, dually for lines. With |P|=(s+1)(st+1), |L|=(t+1)(st+1), E=(s+1)(t+1)(st+1), its cycle rank is s^2 t^2 and the join is a wedge of s^4 t^4 3-spheres. The topology is for finite thick GQ (s,t>=2) and 3<=r<4 only; no general inference from finite symplectic checks.
